Matchbox The Movie - Official Trailer (John Cena, Jessica Biel) | Comic Con 2026
Save the world. Bring your friends. Check out the Matchbox The Movie trailer for this upcoming film starring John Cena, Jessica Biel, Arturo Castro, Sam Richardson, Teyonah Parris, Danai Gurira, Golshifteh Farahani, Corey Stoll, and Bill Camp. Matchbox The Movie streams on Apple TV on October 9, 2026. 

Inspired by the iconic Mattel toys, Matchbox The Movie is an action-packed, globetrotting adventure about a group of friends since childhood who have their lives upended when undercover CIA agent Sean (John Cena), their long-absent former leader, returns to their small town and unwittingly gets them embroiled in a frantic international pursuit to save the world.

An Apple Original Film hailing from Skydance Media and Mattel Films, Matchbox The Movie is directed and executive produced by Sam Hargrave and written by David Coggeshall. David Ellison, Dana Goldberg and Don Granger produce for Skydance, and Robbie Brenner and Ynon Kreiz produce for Mattel Films. Jules Daly also serves as producer. Patrick Newall and Elizabeth Bassin serve as executive producers.

text:
YAGA - Official Teaser Trailer (Carrie-Anne Moss, Hudson Williams) | Comic Con 2026
Her voice will haunt you. Check out the teaser trailer for YAGA, an upcoming mystery thriller 8-episode series starring Carrie-Anne Moss, Noah Reid, Hudson Williams, and Clark Backo. The cast also includes Sheila McCarthy, Megan Follows, Ezra Franky, Patrick Gilmore, Katharine Isabelle, and Hiro Kanagawa, along with Emilija Baranac, Georgia Acken, Anisa Harris, and Sam Krochmal. YAGA premieres this October 2026 on AMC+.

Based on the hit play by showrunner and writer Kat Sandler, YAGA follows Rapp (Noah Reid, Schitt’s Creek, The Vampire Lestat), a private investigator who arrives in a small coastal town to investigate the disappearance of a young heir to a powerful fishery, Henry Park (Hudson Williams, Heated Rivalry). He finds himself at odds with an apprehensive local detective, Carson (Clark Backo, Venom: The Last Dance, Letterkenny), a charismatic university professor with a taste for younger men, Katherine (Carrie-Anne Moss, Matrix Films, Memento), and a labyrinth of enigmatic suspects, secret lives, and ancient magic. 

YAGA, a Crave Original series, is produced by Blink49 Studios and Front Street Pictures in association with Bell Media. David Frazee and Rachel Talalay serve as co-directors; Mackenzie Donaldson, Andrew Miller, and Carrie-Anne Moss are executive producers; and Charles Cooper is producer. 

The series is distributed internationally by Sphere Abacus, a Bell Media company, and was exclusively acquired by AMC Global Media for AMC+ in the United States.

text:
TMNT and Deadpool Get Awesome 1/6th Scale Figures From Mondo | Comic Con 2026
Mondo has been making cool collectibles for ages, but this year’s showing at SDCC blew us away. The Mondoverse line of Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles figures imagine what it might be like if the live-action Jim Henson movies had continued, our pal Peter “AttackPeter” Santa-Maria walks us through the extensive headcanon they’ve made up. Meanwhile, it’s easy to forget that Deadpool’s first non-comics appearance was on the original X-Men The Animated Series, for a couple brief cameos, but Mondo turned those brief glimpses into an incredibly funny collectible that pays homage to the classic cartoon, but also lampoons Mondo’s own SDCC-exclusive Wolverine from a few years back, and Mondo’s Hector Arce walks us through how they got Marvel’s blessing to get so weird with this particular collectible.
